finding: Only 2/5 known-math sources exceeded the frozen detection threshold. Only 2/5 language sources were eligible, and the registry controls were ineligible. Calibration remained incomplete and the detection criterion failed.
limitations: The two eligible language controls are not a 0/5 false-positive result; registry specificity was never measured.
Synthetic controls check the implementation and do not rescue weak real-source detection.
The CRLF source-offset verifier correction preserved scores and frozen experiment files; same operator/code lineage is not an independent audit.
Third-party source texts and offsets remain in the preserved archive. Raw-source republication needs its own notice/rights decision; this smaller selection is not a self-contained calibration bundle.

Preserved archive: PHAISTOS-MATH-02-EVIDENCE.zip. The attached files are inspection selections; they do not replace its complete runtime directory. No public archive URL or permission is implied. Full figures, historical versions and omitted dependencies remain in that archive.
S01–S45 identities and Pen/Pencil alternatives remain as recorded. Display orientation is not proven reading direction; no decoding or acceptance of Visual Families follows.
method: The original frozen calibration held out source documents, preserved the scorer and recorded eligibility gates, synthetic implementation controls, result vectors and a corrected verifier. The original source archive has now been connected to its existing report.
open_questions: Follow-on research remains separate from this completed record; exact publication review does not require a rerun.
